task: Add --package-path flag to publish-pr CLI to eliminate manual PR#5/PR#6 package swapping
problem_statement: publish-pr hardcoded workspace/pr-dry-run/{family}-controlled-pilot. Publishing PR#5 (Jpeg/Tiff/Png) and PR#6 (TableGenerator/TocGenerator/ImageExtractor) required manually swapping directory contents — brittle, unauditable, no git trail.

solution.help_text: Override package path (default: workspace/pr-dry-run/{family}-controlled-pilot/). Use to publish PR groups with separate packages without manual swapping.
solution.wiring: Handler reads getattr(args, 'package_path', None); if truthy, uses Path(value); else falls back to default {family}-controlled-pilot path.
solution.note: Flag is optional — existing commands without --package-path continue to work unchanged
